events.verdict: Arcidiacono (CHI) maintains a legal forearm to Booker's (PHX) side as he drives.
Booker (PHX) drives into but not through Arcidiacono's (CHI) space.
Carter Jr. (CHI) extends into Ayton (PHX) away from the ball, but doesn't dislodge him from his legally obtained position.
Ayton (PHX) moves laterally into Carter Jr.'s (CHI) path on his driving shot attempt
Ayton (PHX) establishes a legal screening position in Holiday's (CHI) path before contact.
Carter Jr. (CHI) moves along Booker's (PHX) path on the drive.
Parker (CHI) has two hands on Ayton's (PHX) back as he tries to back down in the lane after receiving the ball.
Bridges (PHX) and Holiday (CHI) briefly engage off ball.
Carter Jr. (CHI) and Ayton (PHX) make incidental contact as they engage for the rebound.
Holiday (CHI) moves along Booker's (PHX) path and maintains a legal guarding position on his drive.
LAR shows Ariza (PHX) cleanly knocks the ball out of LaVine's (CHI) hand on his drive.
After communicating with the Replay Center, the ruling on the floor of Bulls possession stands as called.
Bridges (PHX) steps on Holiday's (CHI) foot and lunges forward. Holiday does not push or trip Bridges.
Ayton (PHX) establishes a legal screening position in Holiday's (CHI) path before the contact. Holiday briefly delays himself before the shot.
Carter Jr. (CHI) does not make contact with Booker (PHX) while he is in his shooting motion.
Bridges (PHX) cleanly dislodges the ball from Parker (CHI) after he secures the rebound.
Booker (PHX) and Ayton (PHX) make marginal contact with Holiday (CHI) before the timeout is called.
Ariza (PHX) and Bridges (PHX) make marginal contact with Holiday (CHI) near the sideline.
Bridges (PHX) commits a take foul on LaVine (CHI).
Bridges (PHX) commits a take foul on Parker (CHI).
Ayton (PHX) is called for stepping into the lane before the free throw is released.
